title: Video-SafetyBench: A Benchmark for Safety Evaluation of Video LVLMs
reasoning: The paper presents a safety benchmark for evaluating Large Vision-Language Models. A core component of this evaluation is the 'S10-Hate' category, which explicitly benchmarks 'Religious Intolerance' and various forms of discrimination (racial, ethnic, gender, disability). It also evaluates models on categories with significant moral and ethical dimensions, such as violent crimes and sexual content.
